study: Казань: подбор прогулочных точек при временном бюджете

dataset.note: Все 32 активные записи отмечены verified по сообщению пользователя; перед финальным экспериментом зафиксировать новый SHA-256 каталога.

scenario_design.note: Каждый алгоритм получает один и тот же старт, лимит, набор POI и матрицу.

time_model.walking_speed_source: 2GIS help page reports pedestrian ETA based on 5 km/h; used only as a declared scenario assumption
time_model.visit_time_policy: same fixed dwell for every selected place, including start
time_model.rounding: retain full precision for feasibility; round display only

walking_matrix.matrix_type: directed all-to-all; sources and targets are the same ordered list of included POIs; partition into 10x10 blocks
walking_matrix.primary_cost_uses: distance_m / scenario walking speed; provider duration stored as diagnostic only
walking_matrix.network_error_policy: stop matrix acquisition; do not replace with Euclidean distance
walking_matrix.incomplete_response_policy: stop before experiment until repaired or re-fetched
walking_matrix.public_endpoint_policy: verify current usage terms and rate limits; endpoint returned max locations 100 for a 36x36 request, so split into at most 100 origin-destination pairs per request and space request starts by at least 1100 ms; local/pinned engine preferred; never issue one request per route leg

zones.neighbor_definition: undirected edge between zones if minimum directed pedestrian time between any cross-zone POI pair is <= threshold_minutes
zones.neighbor_time_uses: primary walking speed and cached pedestrian distance matrix
zones.isolated_zone_policy: zone can be entered only by the zonal algorithm fallback when no feasible candidate exists in an unvisited adjacent zone
zones.reentry_definition: after collapsing consecutive duplicate zone labels, count each transition into a zone label already encountered earlier
zones.note: Operational graph only; not a claim about administrative or surveyed geographic adjacency.

algorithms.description: At each step select the nearest reachable unvisited POI that fits remaining time; tie-break by place id; stop when no candidate fits.

Prefer feasible unvisited POIs in current zone; otherwise select the nearest feasible POI in an unvisited adjacent zone; if none exists, fall back to the nearest feasible unvisited POI in any zone. Tie-break by zone then place id.
algorithms.zone_policy: prioritize current zone, then unvisited adjacent zone, then global feasible fallback

metrics.diversity_definition: unique zone count/coverage only; catalog lacks normalized POI interest categories

runtime.report: median milliseconds per algorithm call; exclude network, map rendering, and UI

hypothesis_rule.hypothesis: Zone progression reduces total zone reentries versus nearest-feasible baseline while retaining at least 90% of baseline total visited stops.
supported_if: paired total zone_reentry_count is lower for zone_progression_greedy
all generated routes satisfy time budget
hypothesis_rule.interpretation_limit: describes this fixed catalog and scenario set; not user benefit or general superiority

sensitivity.coordinate_jitter_policy: independently displace each verified coordinate by a seeded random bearing and a radius uniformly sampled from 0 to the configured maximum; rebuild matrix using same engine
sensitivity.note: Coordinate jitter is an artificial robustness stress test, not an estimate of actual coordinate error.

randomness.tie_break: lexicographic id (then zone for zone algorithm)

blockers: Catalog does not contain observed visit durations; use declared scenario assumptions only.
Need a complete cached pedestrian distance matrix for the exact coordinate version.
Zone labels and operational adjacency require review against the map; Parks and Gardens may be spatially dispersed.
data_gate.fallback_if_manual_validation_is_not_fea: Run only a clearly labeled exploratory algorithm study on a candidate graph; do not claim validated on-foot route quality in Kazan.
